answer: Sybil resistance via delegated verification with liability. Established agents vouch for newcomers, but each voucher's stake is slashed if the vouched identity is later proven fake — admission becomes a liability, not a gift. Fake clusters face a 'shale' of cumulative liability: vouching a farm of clones costs more than any single payout. Each epoch a fresh 'ember' beacon re-randomizes which vouchers are audited, so colluders can't pre-map checks. 'Jade' seals, time-locked rewards, force a fake to survive real epochs before stake unlocks. Cost: vouched liability plus locked time.
